comment: Accepted deviations of the filters from their documentation, see scripts/check_filter_claims.py; each entry gives the reason.

fi.filterbank_tpt_df.sr: bilinear frequency warping of the band-split filters near the top crossovers: the same deviation for the plain and _tpt_df variants, about 5 times smaller from 96 to 192 kHz, smaller with a lower ftop

fi.filterbanki_tpt_df.sr: bilinear frequency warping of the band-split filters near the top crossovers: the same deviation for the plain and _tpt_df variants, about 5 times smaller from 96 to 192 kHz, smaller with a lower ftop

fi.highpass3e.-3dB: fc is the -0.2 dB passband edge; the doc places the -3 dB point near fc/1.28

fi.highpass6e.-3dB: fc is the -0.2 dB passband edge; the doc places the -3 dB point near fc/1.06

fi.highpass6e_tpt_df.-3dB: fc is the -0.2 dB passband edge; the doc places the -3 dB point near fc/1.06

fi.hilbert.sr: built on pospass, whose band runs from fc to SR/2 - fc by construction (documented)

fi.lowpass3e.-3dB: fc is the -0.2 dB passband edge; the doc places the -3 dB point near 1.28*fc

fi.lowpass6e.-3dB: fc is the -0.2 dB passband edge; the doc places the -3 dB point near 1.06*fc

fi.lowpass6e_tpt_df.-3dB: fc is the -0.2 dB passband edge; the doc places the -3 dB point near 1.06*fc

fi.mth_octave_filterbank.allpass: allpass-complementary means the bands sum to an allpass (odd O, documented); each band output alone is not allpass

fi.mth_octave_filterbank5.sr: bilinear frequency warping of the band-split filters near the top crossovers: the same deviation for the plain and _tpt_df variants, about 5 times smaller from 96 to 192 kHz, smaller with a lower ftop

fi.mth_octave_filterbank_alt_tpt_df.sr: bilinear frequency warping of the band-split filters near the top crossovers: the same deviation for the plain and _tpt_df variants, about 5 times smaller from 96 to 192 kHz, smaller with a lower ftop

fi.mth_octave_filterbank_default.sr: bilinear frequency warping of the band-split filters near the top crossovers: the same deviation for the plain and _tpt_df variants, about 5 times smaller from 96 to 192 kHz, smaller with a lower ftop

fi.mth_octave_filterbank_tpt_df.sr: bilinear frequency warping of the band-split filters near the top crossovers: the same deviation for the plain and _tpt_df variants, about 5 times smaller from 96 to 192 kHz, smaller with a lower ftop

fi.nlf2.sr: r is a loss factor per sample (documented): the decay time scales with the sample rate

fi.pospass.sr: the band runs from fc to SR/2 - fc by construction (documented); -3.01 dB at fc at every rate

fi.pospass6e.-3dB: fc is the -0.2 dB lower passband edge; the doc says the -3 dB point lies below it
fi.pospass6e.sr: lowpass6e(SR/4 - fc) shifted by SR/4: the -3 dB point below the -0.2 dB edge fc moves with the sample rate (documented)

fi.wgr.sr: r is a loss factor per sample (documented): the decay time scales with the sample rate

ve.moog_vcf.sr: the doc says this approximation neglects the one-sample loop delay, which changes the response, mostly at high frequencies
